text:
priya: Opening a small docs PR — adding a migration example for the Optimize toolkit that shows batching + caching (KV prefetch) + a quantization profile. Need short SDK snippets (Python + Go) and a config snippet. PTAL and advise any warnings to call out.

kevin: Thanks. Can you include target model + sequence length? Also link the existing quant profiles page so reviewers can cross-check.

priya: Good call. Target: Llama-2-13B q4_0, short sequences (<=64) as the recommended profile. Batch size 8, kv_prefetch: true for steady throughput. Draft Python SDK snippet below:

```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key="${REDWOOD_KEY}")
resp = client.generate(
  model="llama-2-13b-q4",
  prompt="Summarize: ...",
  max_tokens=128,
  batch_size=8,
  optimize={"kv_prefetch": True}
)
print(resp.text)
```

priya: And a concise Go snippet:

```go
client := redwood.NewClient(os.Getenv("REDWOOD_KEY"))
resp, err := client.Generate(ctx, redwood.GenerateParams{
  Model: "llama-2-13b-q4",
  Prompt: "Summarize: ...",
  MaxTokens: 128,
  BatchSize: 8,
  Optimize: map[string]interface{}{"kv_prefetch": true},
})
if err != nil { log.Fatal(err) }
fmt.Println(resp.Text)
```

maria: nit: in the Python snippet use `client.generate(..., max_tokens=128)` is fine, but please show the import path we standardize on (from redwood import RedwoodClient). Also add link to quant profiles: https://docs.redwood.ai/optimize/quant-profiles

priya: Added the link in the PR description. Also included a short config example for the quant profile (YAML) and a migration note about potential quality differences:

```yaml
quant_profile: q4_shortseq
model: llama-2-13b
sequence_length: 64
batch_size: 8
kv_prefetch: true
```

alex: Quick question — should we recommend `kv_prefetch: true` for all shortseq workloads? We had a field report that prefetch can increase memory pressure.

luisa: FYI from ops: KV prefetch doubled token latency in a couple of customer workloads that had long sequences (>1024). Recommend adding a caution: "Disable kv_prefetch for long-sequence inference or test with representative traffic." Could we add a one-line perf chart or pointer to the telemetry dashboard?

priya: Great catch. I added a migration caution and linked the telemetry dashboard: https://console.redwood.ai/telemetry/optimize/kv-prefetch

kevin: I'll review the PR after lunch. One small comment: use 'q4_shortseq' as the canonical profile id in the docs and add a short FAQ bullet about quality/regression testing.

priya: Done — added FAQ bullet and a tiny eval checklist: run 100 prompt samples, compare perplexity/ANLI metric, and sanity-check hallucination rate.

kevin: I'll do it.

priya: Fixed the link and merged the PR. :tada:

priya: Thanks y'all. Follow-up: will open a tiny e2e test in examples/optimize to show the end-to-end script (not required for this PR).
